title: Moodiy script spec: script.json
description: The manifest of one script, scripts/<id>/script.json. See docs/spec.md. A schema cannot check the rules that need the file system or other fields: the folder name must equal id, files must not repeat the entry or each other when compared case-insensitively, sha256 may only name the entry or a listed file, sizes and checksums must match, and a Unix entry must start with a shebang. Run tools/validate.mjs for those. Fields this schema does not know are ignored by clients.

name.description: The name shown to people, one line.

detail.description: A path to a self-contained html file in the script folder, at most 200 KB. It is shown to people and never installed.

entry.description: The file that is run. A name that ends in .js is JavaScript run inside Moodiy; anything else is a Unix script that must start with a shebang.

files.description: Extra files to install next to the entry. The entry is implied and must not be repeated. With the entry, at most 100 files.

sha256.description: Checksums of the entry and of listed files: the path, then 64 lowercase hex digits. A file without a checksum is shown to the user as unverified.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; starts with a letter or a digit; at most 64 characters. The folder name is the same.

version.description: A string such as 1.0, 1.2.3 or 1.0-beta. A number is accepted too, but a number cannot keep a trailing zero (1.10 is read as 1.1), so write a string.

path.description: A relative path with / separators: no leading or trailing /, no empty, . or .. segment, no backslash, no control character.
